title: MIRASON Insulated Cooler Backpack

comparisons.notes: Khaki variant; exact dims 30.5x38.5x19.5cm (=11.81x14.57x6.69in); same 4 colors as MIRASON RH2435; visual match to Woot khaki bag (white-label patch FRISCHE vs Mirason); in stock

writeup: This new khaki MIRASON RH2435 insulated cooler backpack is $12.99. It's a leakproof soft cooler with four pockets, and the listing says it stays cold about 20 hours with ice packs. Gadgetdrop has the same khaki size in stock (11.81 x 14.57 x 6.69 in, matching the MIRASON dimensions and color set) at $24.99, so this is 48% and about $12 below that live price. Woot showed 3+ left, with a limit of 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Verifier marked amazon_asin_verified B0F2SMYMW5 as an exact match for the khaki MIRASON RH2435 insulated cooler backpack.
